name: sparsew2t smoke on Kaggle CPU (12 tests + one synthetic run)
command: pip install -q tabulate baostock > $CQ_OUTPUT_DIR/pip.log 2>&1; python -c 'import sys, torch, pandas, numpy, scipy, sklearn; print(sys.version, torch.__version__, pandas.__version__, numpy.__version__)' > $CQ_OUTPUT_DIR/versions.txt 2>&1; OMP_NUM_THREADS=4 python -W ignore tests/test_smoke.py > $CQ_OUTPUT_DIR/test.log 2>&1; grep -q '12/12 passed' $CQ_OUTPUT_DIR/test.log && OMP_NUM_THREADS=4 python -W ignore scripts/run_experiment.py --config configs/smoke.yaml --override experiment.device=cpu --out $CQ_OUTPUT_DIR/run > $CQ_OUTPUT_DIR/run.log 2>&1 && cp $(ls -d $CQ_OUTPUT_DIR/run/*/*/ | head -1)*.csv $CQ_OUTPUT_DIR/ && touch $CQ_OUTPUT_DIR/DONE
